# Standing instructions and composition: is this moment mine?

No identifiers on purpose: the question here is only whether the moment belongs to this region. -->

## What this region is

How Foundry composes standing instructions itself, for any harness: a registered ladder of instruction nodes discovered like Claude Code, filtered by tier and deduped, and the composition view that applies that one ladder to every slot (instructions, domainKnowledge) of every role, with budgets and refresh.

## What it exists for

- Find and compose the standing instruction files
- Drop repeated instruction text
- Notice instruction files changed
- Stop the harness loading instruction files itself
- Build a middleware role's composed layers
- Compose instruction text from parts
- Read the composition settings
- Change what one role reads

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- which version of the Warden's instructions did that call see → audit-log
- add a Warden for the payments region of this project → chorus
- change what the point charter asks the Warden → classify
- make a new kind of context source with its own cache → context-memory
- the settings save didn't bump the revision → settings-runtime
